30-SECOND OVERVIEW

MMCATS Modern
Problem
Preserve asset-management behavior while replacing an obsolete Rails foundation.
My ownership
I directed the modernization, defined parity contracts and reviewed implementation and verification.
Key decision
Use a Rails monolith with database constraints, explicit lifecycle events and private attachments.
Verified result
22 October 2026: 66 tests, 568 assertions, zero failures, errors or skips; local deployment regressions pass.
Current status
Locally verified · public release blocked
Technical focus
Behavioral parity, authorization, auditability and recovery. Historical data was not migrated; security dispositions and provider acceptance remain pending.
Explore the evidence ↓

30-SECOND OVERVIEW

NAAE
Problem
Make a scene recognizable at a distance while preserving meaningful narrative characters up close.
My ownership
I directed the visual language, rendering constraints and iterative review of the procedural engine.
Key decision
Reserve exact narrative text before allocating semantic glyph texture; separate occupancy from intensity.
Verified result
Saved Organic v0.3 and Pixel-Hybrid v0.4 artifacts expose configuration and integrity diagnostics.
Current status
Local prototype · public studio pending
Technical focus
Seeded geometry, source integrity and bounded character budgets. Scene mode is experimental; physical print quality and official release dates are unverified.
Explore the evidence ↓
